newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Power sees 900 MW unit up end-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Power sees 900 MW unit up end-Oct.

text.p: Georgia Power Co said it expects the 900 megawatt (MW) Scherer coal-fired generating unit in Juliette, Ga., to resume operation at the end of October after being shut Monday for seasonal maintenance.
Scherer's three other units, also rated at 900 MW each, were operating at full output, a company spokesman said.
Georgia Power, the operator of Scherer, owns 16 percent interest in unit 4; Florida Power & Light Co 66 percent; and Jacksonville Electric Authority of Florida 18 percent.
Georgia Power is a subsidiary of The Southern Co.
